Malov’s archival study (Ural State University journal, 2004, no. 33, printed p. 162) places Kozlovsky’s departure and the subsequent siege in autumn 1658; Lobanov-Rostovsky receives November pay before arriving at Mscislaŭ already besieged by Kozlovsky. Only 1658 is entered. The exact opening month/day is not established here, and no 1 January start is asserted. Existing April 1659 end and sourced siege-town coordinates are retained.
